content.rendered: The Sherwood School District is EXCITED to celebrate “Staff Appreciation Week” during the week of March 19! — There is no other greater source of inspiration and motivation than to walk into work every morning and be greeted by the smiles of friendly and supportive staff of the SSD. Thank you for making Sherwood Schools a great place for all kids.
